_what: All 21 Cap.50 facts checked against the NSSF Act R.E.2023, read directly.
_mode: REPORT ONLY -- no fact edited. Disagreements reported for decision first.

act.rejected_sources: kazi.go.tz copies (R.E.2015 and R.E.2018) and the TanzLII PDF that labels itself not the latest version -- the superseded-edition trap

findings.verbatim: Employer's share deductible from wages by Employer: Ten cents for every complete shilling of wages
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: Statutory Contributions for each employee: Twenty cents for every complete shilling of wages
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: a contribution that consist of the employer's and employee's share at the rate stipulated in the First Schedule (total 20%, employer limb 10%)
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED (by subtraction, 20% total less the 10% employer limb)

findings.verbatim: 20% of 12 x 600,000 = 1,440,000 (arithmetic on the confirmed statutory rate)
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: a sum equal to five per centum of the amount unpaid shall be added as penalty for each month or a part of a month after the date when payment should have been made
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED -- UPGRADE AVAILABLE: currently cited only to the nssf.go.tz/pages/payment-of-contributions portal page, which returns HTTP 500. Now sourceable at statute tier.

findings.verbatim: a sum equal to five per centum of the amount unpaid
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.claim: each month or a part of a month
findings.verbatim: for each month or a part of a month after the date when payment should have been made
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED -- verbatim, including the 'part of a month' limb

findings.claim: within one month after the payroll month ends; 5%/month if late
findings.verbatim: within one month after the end of the month in respect of which the contributions are due and payable
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.claim: 60 pensionable; 55 = early retirement within 5 years of pensionable age
findings.verbatim: "pensionable age" means the age of sixty years | 25.(c) who has attained the age of fifty-five or above but before attaining pensionable age | 29.-(1) An insured person who is within five retirement years of the pensionable age and has paid contributions for at least 180 months, may claim early retirement
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED -- and this is the ONE Cap.50 fact already citing R.E.2023

findings.verbatim: "pensionable age" means the age of sixty years
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: in respect of whom not less than 180 monthly contributions have been paid
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: to an insured person who has made at least thirty-six monthly contributions of which twelve contributions are made in the th[irty-six months...]
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED -- with an ADDITIONAL statutory condition the fact omits: twelve of the thirty-six must fall in the recent window. Not a contradiction; an incompleteness worth recording.

findings.verbatim: cash benefit at the rate of 100 per centum of the average daily earnings for a period of twelve weeks
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: 100 per centum of the average DAILY earnings
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED -- note the base is average DAILY earnings, which the bare '100%' does not convey

findings.verbatim: An employer shall, within six months before the date of retirement of his employee, notify the Fund in writing about the date of retirement
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: the Fund shall, within sixty days following the date of retirement, pay to the member the due retirement pension benefits
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED -- and s.51(3) adds a limb worth having: if the Fund misses that deadline through no fault of the member it owes the principal plus a penalty of fifteen percent per annum.

findings.verbatim: or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years or to both
findings.verdict: VALUE CONFIRMED

findings.verbatim: commits an offence and on conviction shall be liable to a fine not exceeding TEN MILLION SHILLINGS or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years or to both
findings.verdict: 🔴 WRONG VALUE -- the Act says TEN MILLION shillings, the fact says one hundred thousand. A 100x understatement of the maximum fine, on a fact that had primary_source: None and so was never checked by anyone.

findings.verbatim: s.23(1)(g) lists 'health benefit' as a class of benefit; NO contribution-month condition for it appears anywhere in the Act body
findings.verdict: ⚠️ UNVERIFIABLE FROM Cap.50 -- searched every occurrence of 'health' in the enacting body; the 3-month qualifying period is not there. It is presumably in regulations or the Social Security Act. NOT contradicted, NOT confirmed.

findings.verbatim: 12.-(2) The employer may opt to contribute a greater rate than the amount stipulated in subsection (1). (3) Where the employer agrees to contribute at a greater rate or the whole contribution rate, such option shall not apply to a member whose contribution rate ... does not exceed fifty percent
findings.verdict: ⚠️ CONCEPT CONFIRMED, ENUMERATION NOT. The Act establishes the 20% total and that an employer MAY opt to pay a greater share up to the whole, which makes 15+5 and 20+0 lawful. It does not enumerate those three splits -- that framing is portal-sourced. Defensible, but the fact should not imply the statute lists them.

findings.claim: register at or shortly after commencement of business -- verify at nssf.go.tz
findings.verbatim: every contributing employer shall, unless such employer has been registered under the existing Fund, within one month, register under this section in the prescribed manner | (2) The period of one month ... shall, in every case, begin upon the commencement of this Act or the date when the person concerned becomes a contributing employer
findings.verdict: ⭐ HEDGE NOW RESOLVABLE. The fact currently says 'verify deadline at nssf.go.tz' and is marked unverifiable. The Act gives a precise answer: WITHIN ONE MONTH of becoming a contributing employer. This is an upgrade from a hedge to a statute-grounded value, not a correction of a wrong one.
